content.text: Good match (0.983). Slight red at inner hole — hole a touch bigger; thickness maybe slightly less. Tweak and export.
Back to the best (3 mm thick, hole Ø50), centred, and export.

I built the part as a flat spacer ring and exported it to `submission.step`. Its silhouettes match the reference at a mean IoU of 0.983 across the four views.

- **Shape:** a 100 mm outer diameter, 50 mm hole and 3 mm thickness, with the ring's axis along world X. Only the proportions matter for scoring, so the absolute size is arbitrary.
- **Orientation:** I first tried the axis along Z, which scored only 0.40. Turning it to X made all four views line up.
- **Tuning:** I also tried a 52 mm hole with 2.5 mm thickness (0.962), a 49 mm hole (0.977) and 3.5 mm thickness (0.981). All scored lower, so I kept the original sizes.
- **Export:** I re-centred the ring on the origin before exporting. The STEP file was read back as one valid solid matching the part. I didn't re-run the image comparison after the shift, but it changes only the position, not the shape.

The part was made with one CadQuery script, so the validator flags that it has no editable feature tree. That doesn't matter for scoring the STEP file.
